list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "system" WITH KEY = "host"

targets.query: SELECT last("uptime") FROM "system" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("usage_active") FROM "cpu" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "cpu"='cpu-total' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("load1") / mean("n_cpus") FROM "system" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("used_percent") FROM "mem" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("used_percent") FROM "swap" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("used_percent") FROM "disk" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "path"='/' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("temp") FROM "temp" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "sensor" =~ /^(coretemp_package_id_0|k10temp_tctl|cpu_thermal)$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("utilization_gpu") FROM "nvidia_smi" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("temperature_gpu") FROM "nvidia_smi" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("memory_used") / mean("memory_total") * 100 FROM "nvidia_smi" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("rx") FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("bytes_recv"), 1s) AS "rx" FROM "net" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("tx") FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("bytes_sent"), 1s) AS "tx" FROM "net" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_user") FROM "cpu" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "cpu"='cpu-total' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_system") FROM "cpu" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "cpu"='cpu-total' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_iowait") FROM "cpu" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "cpu"='cpu-total' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_steal") FROM "cpu" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "cpu"='cpu-total' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_active") FROM "cpu" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "cpu" != 'cpu-total' GROUP BY time($__interval), "cpu" fill(null)
SELECT mean("load1") AS "1m", mean("load5") AS "5m", mean("load15") AS "15m" FROM "system" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("temp") FROM "temp" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "sensor" fill(null)

SELECT mean("used") AS "used", mean("cached") AS "cached", mean("buffered") AS "buffered", mean("available") AS "available" FROM "mem" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("used") AS "used" FROM "swap" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("utilization_gpu") AS "gpu", mean("utilization_memory") AS "memory controller" FROM "nvidia_smi" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("memory_used") AS "used", mean("memory_total") AS "total" FROM "nvidia_smi" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("temperature_gpu") AS "gpu" FROM "nvidia_smi" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("power_draw") AS "draw", mean("power_limit") AS "limit" FROM "nvidia_smi" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("fan_speed") AS "fan" FROM "nvidia_smi" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("used_percent") FROM "disk" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "path"

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("read_bytes"), 1s) AS "read", non_negative_derivative(mean("write_bytes"), 1s) AS "write" FROM "diskio" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "name" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("reads"), 1s) AS "reads", non_negative_derivative(mean("writes"), 1s) AS "writes" FROM "diskio" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "name" fill(null)
SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("io_time"), 1s) / 10 FROM "diskio" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "name" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("bytes_recv"), 1s) AS "rx", non_negative_derivative(mean("bytes_sent"), 1s) AS "tx" FROM "net" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("err_in"),1s) AS "err in", non_negative_derivative(mean("err_out"),1s) AS "err out", non_negative_derivative(mean("drop_in"),1s) AS "drop in", non_negative_derivative(mean("drop_out"),1s) AS "drop out" FROM "net" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)

SELECT mean("tcp_established") AS "established", mean("tcp_time_wait") AS "time_wait", mean("tcp_close_wait") AS "close_wait", mean("tcp_listen") AS "listen" FROM "netstat" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT mean("running") AS "running", mean("sleeping") AS "sleeping", mean("blocked") AS "blocked", mean("zombies") AS "zombies" FROM "processes" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("context_switches"), 1s) AS "context switches/s", non_negative_derivative(mean("interrupts"), 1s) AS "interrupts/s" FROM "kernel" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage_percent") FROM "docker_container_cpu" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter AND "cpu"='cpu-total' GROUP BY time($__interval), "container_name" fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage") FROM "docker_container_mem" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "container_name" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("rx_bytes"), 1s) AS "rx", non_negative_derivative(mean("tx_bytes"), 1s) AS "tx" FROM "docker_container_net" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "container_name" fill(null)
